{{Quote|You need to remove those boarding ships from the hangar door!|[[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] talking to [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Boarding Pod''' was a craft used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to land combined [[Infantry/Legends|Infantry]] and armor boarding parties aboard enemy vessels.

==Characteristics==
This boarding craft bore the shape of an octagonal prism and was capable of transporting both [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] and [[Assault vehicle/Legends|assault vehicles]] such as the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] and the [[All Terrain Missile Platform/Legends|AT-MP]] aboard enemy ships. The ship would latch onto the hangar door, blocking any ships from exiting the hangar, lower its own door and deactivate the hangar [[Force field/Legends|force field]]. The troops and vehicles could then disembark through a ramp. The pod was a short range craft, so it had to be launched directly from a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] or other capital ship.

The craft was capable of carrying several squads of infantrymen such as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] as well a combat vehicles such as the AT-ST. Since the pod was unarmed, it was vulnerable while flying towards its target.

==History==
One of the pod's most notable uses was at the [[Assault on Kamino]]. During the battle, it was used by the Empire to deploy heavy ordnance such as AT-STs and AT-MPs aboard the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] ship, the [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']]. These vehicles were supported by squads of stormtroopers while they boarded and engaged enemy forces. [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]] helped the Rebels defeat the boarding parties and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to destroy the locking mechanisms that were keeping the Boarding Pods attached to the hangar door. This allowed the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] aboard the Salvation to launch and join the battle against the Imperial fleet.
